title: iPhone free for 10 min while 1 job waits

messages.text:
The iPhone has had no holder for 10 min (since 15:50Z; the lease of int-v8 ran out). The limit is 5 min.
Waiting on the status board: v10 (owner int-v8; its next step names the phone (unmarked)).
What unblocks it: the next of int-v8 takes it (node tools/lock.mjs acquire iphone --owner <you> ...).
No steward on duty (mgmt-devices is parked): the lead handles this thread (I-175).
One message per idle period; this thread closes by itself when the slot is taken (tools/idle.mjs, I-105).

False alarm: no job was waiting for the phone; the v10 row named the phone as a later step, which the alarm read as waiting.
- I corrected the row at 16:01Z; the alarm now reads no ready work.
- The phone is next needed for the v10 check, around 17:10Z.
What you need to do: nothing.
Ok, i'd like to use my phone.

The iPhone is yours: booked for you from 16:09Z for 30 min; no agent will touch it.
- The v10 check needs it around 17:10Z; it waits for you if you are still on it.
What you need to do: use the phone, then write "done" here so I release it.

The iPhone is not connected to the Mac right now, which is fine while you use it (yours until 16:39Z).
- The Mac sees no iPhone on USB, so no agent can reach it; your time is not affected.
- Next on the phone: the v10 test (the best build plus the GPU end-of-page change), run by int-v8 once the phone is back.
What you need to do: when you are done, plug the iPhone back into the Mac, unlocked, and reply "done" here.

Your phone time now runs to 17:05Z (extended 30 min), because the iPhone is still off the Mac.
- Nothing is lost: the v10 iPhone test (3 versions, about 55 min) is ready and starts as soon as the phone is back.
- Reply "done" earlier and I release your time at once.
What you need to do: when you are done, plug the iPhone back in, unlocked, and reply "done" here.

Thanks, the iPhone is back: the Mac lists it again, and I released your phone time at 16:41Z.
- Next on the phone: the v10 test, 3 versions (current build, v10, v10 with the faster first open), about 55 min, run by int-v8.
- Please leave the phone plugged in and untouched until it ends; your blind swipe test comes right after.
What you need to do: nothing now; I post the swipe test in your steps when the run is done.
